tv_reconstruct — TOMOGRAPHY ct_scan op

• 데이터 종류: projstack × ctgeometry → voxel

• 호출: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.tv_reconstruct(projections, geometry, tv_weight=0.0003, n_iter=200, initial=None, nonnegative=True, device='auto', on_iter=None)(구현을 직접 호출하려면 import ctscan; ctscan.tv_reconstruct(projections, geometry, tv_weight=0.0003, n_iter=200, initial=None, nonnegative=True, device='auto', on_iter=None), 원장에서 가져오려면 opstomography.get("tv_reconstruct"))

• GPU: 없음(CPU 참조 구현만)

사용법

Chambolle-Pock 원시-쌍대 방법에 의한 총변동 재구성.

> 아래 상세 설명은 원문입니다 —— 요약과 제목은 번역되어 있습니다.

Solves min 0.5 ||A x - p||^2 + w ||grad x||_1 with x >= 0, in the form Sidky, Jorgensen & Pan 2012 give for CT. The prior says that the object is piecewise constant, which is what lets it fill data that was never measured: few views and limited angle. On an object that is not piecewise constant it paints the same flat patches, so a low residual here is not evidence of truth.

*tv_weight* is in units of ||A||^2 times the volume scale, so that one value behaves alike across grid sizes.

:param projections: (view, V, U) line integrals. :param geometry: dict from ct_scan_geometry. :param tv_weight: strength of the prior, >= 0. :param n_iter: primal-dual iterations, 1 .. 5000. :param initial: starting volume; None gives zeros. :param nonnegative: enforce x >= 0. :param device: "auto", "cpu" or "cuda". :param on_iter: optional on_iter(iteration, volume). :returns: (Z, Y, X) float volume. :raises ValueError: on a shape that disagrees with the geometry or a negative

weight. Empty input (projections with 0 elements) raises ValueError.

참고(샘플 데이터·문헌)

• 샘플 데이터 카탈로그(DL URL / 라이선스) —— 2-D 는 skimage.data(BSD/public)+ 합성, 3-D 는 실데이터 소스(Stanford/PDS 등)의 DL URL.

• 연산자의 내력·참고문헌 —— 이 연산자 족의 바탕이 된 연구/기법의 출처.

• 알고리즘의 정전(저자·연도)과 용도는 위의 패밀리 사용 가이드에 적혀 있습니다.
